_comment: Quick command buttons. Edit this file to add your own; changes take effect
when the page is reloaded.
Fields:
id        : unique identifier
label     : text shown on the button (English)
label_tr  : optional Turkish label, used when the UI is set to TR
commands  : MAVProxy-syntax commands, executed in order
inputs    : optional numeric input boxes
confirm   : true shows a confirmation dialog
style     : primary | danger | normal (appearance only)
desc      : tooltip (English); desc_tr is its Turkish counterpart
Placeholders {name} are filled from inputs. {name*100} applies a multiplier
(e.g. metres -> centimetres).
A button may instead carry:
procedure_role : 'takeoff' or 'land' — runs the procedure the connected
vehicle's own capabilities select, from
argazui/procedures/*.yaml. The inputs come from the
procedure, not from this file, and the regression tests
run the very same YAML. See procedures/SCHEMA.md.
procedure      : a specific procedure id, bypassing the selection.
Buttons with 'commands' are unchanged and keep working exactly as in v1.0.
Command syntax understood by the MAVLink interpreter:
mode <MODE>           arm throttle [force]    disarm [force]
takeoff <metres>      param set <NAME> <VALUE>  rc <channel> <pwm>
Anything else is forwarded to the SIMULATION terminal.

Copter.label: ARM
Copter.desc: Switches to GUIDED and arms the motors

Copter.label: ARM (FORCE)
Copter.desc: Arms the motors BYPASSING the pre-arm checks. An escape hatch for models whose parameter file is a real hardware dump that does not settle in SITL (e.g. the Swan-K1 tailsitter). NEVER use this on a real aircraft.
Copter.desc_tr: ARM oncesi kontrolleri ATLAYARAK motorlari kurar. Param dosyasi gercek donanimdan gelen ve SITL'de tam oturmayan modeller icin kacis yolu (ornek: Swan-K1 tailsitter). Gercek ucusta ASLA kullanma.

Copter.label: TAKEOFF
Copter.desc: Runs the takeoff procedure selected for this vehicle and verifies it actually climbed
Copter.desc_tr: Bu arac icin secilen kalkis prosedurunu calistirir ve gercekten tirmandigini dogrular

Copter.label: LAND
Copter.desc: Runs the landing procedure selected for this vehicle and verifies it reached disarm
Copter.desc_tr: Bu arac icin secilen inis prosedurunu calistirir ve disarm'a ulastigini dogrular

Copter.label: CIRCLE
Copter.desc: NOTE: on this ArduPilot version the parameter is CIRCLE_RADIUS_M and its unit is METRES. The old centimetre-based CIRCLE_RADIUS has been removed.
Copter.desc_tr: DIKKAT: bu ArduPilot surumunde parametre CIRCLE_RADIUS_M ve birimi METRE. Eski cm'lik CIRCLE_RADIUS kaldirilmis.

Plane.label: ARM (FORCE)
Plane.desc: Arms the motors BYPASSING the pre-arm checks. An escape hatch for models whose parameter file is a real hardware dump that does not settle in SITL (e.g. the Swan-K1 tailsitter). NEVER use this on a real aircraft.
Plane.desc_tr: ARM oncesi kontrolleri ATLAYARAK motorlari kurar. Param dosyasi gercek donanimdan gelen ve SITL'de tam oturmayan modeller icin kacis yolu (ornek: Swan-K1 tailsitter). Gercek ucusta ASLA kullanma.

Plane.label: TAKEOFF
Plane.desc: Runway takeoff in TAKEOFF mode. v1.0 sent a Copter-style GUIDED + MAV_CMD_NAV_TAKEOFF here, which ArduPlane cannot act on for a fixed wing — see argazui/procedures/plane_takeoff.yaml.
Plane.desc_tr: TAKEOFF modunda pist kalkisi. v1.0 burada Copter usulu GUIDED + MAV_CMD_NAV_TAKEOFF gonderiyordu; ArduPlane sabit kanatta bu komutu isleyemez — bkz. argazui/procedures/plane_takeoff.yaml.

Plane.label: LAND
Plane.desc: Automatic fixed-wing approach and landing (AUTOLAND), verified through to disarm. Needs a takeoff that captured the takeoff direction.
Plane.desc_tr: Otomatik sabit kanat yaklasmasi ve inisi (AUTOLAND), disarm'a kadar dogrulanir. Kalkis yonunun yakalandigi bir kalkis gerektirir.

Plane.label: LOITER (radius)
Plane.desc: On Plane the radius-controlled circle is LOITER; WP_LOITER_RAD is in METRES. (Plane's CIRCLE mode is a fixed-bank circle with no radius.)
Plane.desc_tr: Plane'de yaricapi ayarlanabilen daire LOITER modudur; WP_LOITER_RAD METRE cinsindendir. (Plane'in CIRCLE modu sabit yatis acili, yaricapsizdir.)

Plane.label: CIRCLE
Plane.desc: Plane CIRCLE mode: a gentle fixed-bank circle that works without GPS. It has NO radius parameter.
Plane.desc_tr: Plane CIRCLE modu: GPS'siz, sabit yatis acili nazik daire. Yaricap parametresi YOKTUR.

VTOL.label: ARM (FORCE)
VTOL.desc: Arms the motors BYPASSING the pre-arm checks. An escape hatch for models whose parameter file is a real hardware dump that does not settle in SITL (e.g. the Swan-K1 tailsitter). NEVER use this on a real aircraft.
VTOL.desc_tr: ARM oncesi kontrolleri ATLAYARAK motorlari kurar. Param dosyasi gercek donanimdan gelen ve SITL'de tam oturmayan modeller icin kacis yolu (ornek: Swan-K1 tailsitter). Gercek ucusta ASLA kullanma.

VTOL.label: Q-TAKEOFF
VTOL.desc: Vertical takeoff. A tailsitter gets its own procedure automatically — the choice is made from Q_ENABLE / Q_TAILSIT_ENABLE / Q_OPTIONS read from the aircraft, not from the registry.
VTOL.desc_tr: Dikey kalkis. Tailsitter'a kendi proseduru otomatik verilir — secim kayit defterinden degil, aractan okunan Q_ENABLE / Q_TAILSIT_ENABLE / Q_OPTIONS degerlerinden yapilir.

VTOL.label: QLAND
VTOL.desc: Vertical landing, verified through to disarm

VTOL.label: LOITER (radius)
VTOL.desc: Fixed-wing LOITER for a QuadPlane; WP_LOITER_RAD is in METRES.
VTOL.desc_tr: QuadPlane sabit kanat LOITER'i; WP_LOITER_RAD METRE cinsindendir.

VTOL.label: CIRCLE
VTOL.desc: Plane CIRCLE mode: a gentle fixed-bank circle that works without GPS. It has NO radius parameter.
VTOL.desc_tr: Plane CIRCLE modu: GPS'siz, sabit yatis acili nazik daire. Yaricap parametresi YOKTUR.
